scope: one decision per ECG on the held SPH development components; not independent validation
input_policy: the sealed development cutoffs from job 33362, no refitting or inspection of held outcomes to choose this joint rule
signed_margin: minimum of P8 and P4 profile confidence minus each profile's own frozen cutoff
route: accept if signed margin is nonnegative; otherwise abstain. Technical unscored records remain unscored.
accepted_prediction: emit the unchanged P8 and P4 label sets, including original P8 fallback when present
abstained_prediction: emit no label set; original model predictions retained only for a counterfactual comparison
cascade: not implemented; no referral, review, or stage-two prediction inferred
risk: mean per-ECG binary statement error across all mapped P8/P4 endpoints
